svg.title: Crude Oil Transport: Persian Gulf & Strait of Hormuz
svg.desc: Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, the Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline, and loading areas at Fujairah, Sohar and off Mina al Fahal. Schematic routes do not show live vessel traffic or facility operations.

svg.text: Sea arrows show schematic vessel round trips, not two-way crude flows or individual voyages. Green arrows show pipeline flow.
Rings mark representative handling sites; crossings do not imply connections. STS = ship-to-ship transfer; SBM = offshore buoy loading. Routes do not show live traffic, safety, operations or volumes.
Map: Watanave Laboratory, The University of Tokyo
